name: Currentia
tagline: The home charging system your e-bike and scooter actually deserve.
positioning: Currentia gives individuals a smart dock, battery-health tracking, and off-peak scheduling so every ride starts fully charged and every battery lasts longer.

hero.h1: Charge every ride the right way, right at home.
hero.sub: Currentia pairs a smart dock with battery-health insight and automatic off-peak scheduling, so your e-bike, scooter, or personal EV is ready when you are — and lasts for years.

features.title: One dock, every vehicle
features.description: A single Currentia dock adapts to e-bikes, scooters, and personal EVs, so you stop juggling three chargers and a tangle of adapters in the hallway.

features.title: Battery health you can see
features.description: Track charge cycles, temperature, and capacity fade for each battery, with plain-language alerts before a cell quietly starts to degrade.

features.title: Charges when power is cheapest
features.description: Currentia learns your morning departure and shifts charging into off-peak windows, trimming your bill without you lifting a finger.

features.title: Grid- and solar-aware
features.description: Connect a solar setup or time-of-use tariff and the dock prioritizes clean, low-cost electrons whenever they're available.

features.title: Built-in thermal safeguards
features.description: Automatic current limiting and thermal cutoffs keep lithium batteries in their safe zone, so you can charge indoors with peace of mind.

features.title: Charge from your phone
features.description: Start, pause, and check status from anywhere, and get a nudge when a battery is topped off or needs attention.

testimonials.quote: I commute 14 miles each way on an e-bike, and Currentia is the first thing that made me stop worrying about my battery. It charges overnight during off-peak hours and tells me exactly how much life is left.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: We have two scooters and my partner's e-moped in the garage. One dock handles all three now, and the health tracking flagged a failing cell months before it would have stranded me.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramachandran

testimonials.quote: The scheduling alone paid for the subscription. My charging costs dropped noticeably once Currentia started shifting everything to my cheapest tariff window automatically.
testimonials.name: Elena Voss

pricing.blurb: Everything one rider needs to charge smarter at home.
For households with several vehicles and higher expectations.
features: Up to three vehicles per dock

pricing.blurb: For heavy riders and small fleets who charge every day.

homepage.footerBlurb: Currentia builds home charging systems that keep micro-mobility batteries healthy, affordable, and ready to ride.
